description: Stability check and stress test tool: CPU, memory, GPU, VRAM, power supply and storage tests, benchmarks and hardware monitoring.
notes: OCCT Personal is free for personal use only; using it at work needs a paid edition (see ocbase.com).
Runs as administrator: Windows shows a UAC prompt on every start.
On start it unpacks its test programs (about 400 MB) into a temporary folder.
Settings (OCCT.config.json) are kept in $persist_dir and survive updates.
Do not accept OCCT's own update offer: it would replace OCCT.exe inside the Scoop version folder.
Turn off 'Check for updates' in OCCT's settings and update with 'scoop update OCCT' instead.
pre_install: # OCCT keeps its settings in OCCT.config.json next to OCCT.exe. It is copied in here and back out
# in pre_uninstall (which also runs on update) instead of persisted: a hardlink would break if OCCT replaces the file.
